criteria.requirement: The answer provides one unambiguous, minimal runnable Typer example that can be invoked as python shop.py 咖啡 --quantity 3 and produces 咖啡:3. The controller temporarily extracts and executes it from the frozen answer; the model must not be required to write files first.
Omitting quantity gives 1; 0 is accepted; negative values and invalid integers are rejected. Negative values must not be clamped to 0.
Explain that a single command is invoked directly, without adding product; --help only displays help, and invalid parameters produce an understandable error with a nonzero exit.

Respect the instruction not to create files yet: neither app nor library in the evaluated workspace may be modified. Temporary execution of the example by the verifier does not constitute a code checkpoint.

answer_extraction.rule: Prefer a complete Python main program; combine fragments only when no complete program is present. Deduplicate syntactically equivalent repetitions, and reject ambiguity when multiple distinct complete main programs are provided.

equivalent_answers: Different valid Typer integration forms are allowed. Judge actual CLI behavior and the absence of file writes; copying the reference code is not required.
